title: nan
authors: Rao N.; Sundaram S.; Raghavendra V.
key_contribution: Presents a spectral-normalized memory neural network estimator using rotor RPMs fused with an EKF for computationally light GPS-denied position estimation of micro-UAVs, validated with flight data.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
